_comment: Phase 3 characters v2 golden: a Java string equality INTERVIEW, language java, from content/java_string_equality.md section 2.1. Every fact is in that section: == compares references, equals compares the characters, two strings built at run time are two objects. Also the stub answer for the interview theme on the Java lesson.
topic: Why does == report false for two strings with the same letters?
hook_question: Why does my string check say false for same letters?

shots.speech: Why does my string check say false for same letters?

shots.speech: Because double equals compares references, not the text.
